definitions.explanation: The person or company whose bid wins an auction or a tender, including online auctions and public works contracts.

examples.japanese: {落札者|らくさつしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: The winning bidder has been decided.

examples.japanese: {落札者|らくさつしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発送|はっそう}する→発送する：21737_hassousuru⟧。
examples.english: To ship the item to the winning bidder.

examples.japanese: ⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧オークション⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{落札者|らくさつしゃ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{代金|だいきん}→代金：03416_daikin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{振|ふ}り{込|こ}まれた→振り込む：10992_furikomu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{品物|しなもの}→品物：00886_shinamono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}った→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: The winning bidder in the online auction transferred the payment, so I sent the item right away.

notes:
Made of ⟦{落札|らくさつ}→落札：31658_rakusatsu⟧ (winning a bid) + 〜⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). The other side of the sale is the ⟦{出品者|しゅっぴんしゃ}→出品者：32437_shuppinsha⟧ (the seller who listed the item).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {落札者|らくさつしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まる→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧: the winning bidder is decided
- {落札者|らくさつしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}する→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧: to contact the winning bidder

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {入札者|にゅうさつしゃ}: bidder (anyone who bids)
- ⟦{出品者|しゅっぴんしゃ}→出品者：32437_shuppinsha⟧: seller, the person who listed the item
